detailedNarrative: CASE021 (FIR/CYBERCRIME/2025/0021) — Cyber Fraud (Online Investment Scam) registered at PS Cyber Crime CHD, Chandigarh. Incident recorded on 2025-04-04 19:36 at Sector 15 Residential, Chandigarh. FIR records 2 accused (Aman Chauhan P00350, Sukha P00020) and 4 named persons in total. 991 records across 5 sources; 21 transactions flagged for review. Money-flow records show funds received and forwarded within minutes (e.g. EVD-TXN003130 → EVD-TXN003131, 41.0 min), a pattern that can indicate layering and requires verification. 8 transfers from P00350 to P00020 each fell just below ₹50,000 (total ₹333,993). Account HDFC-25216025239 received funds from 3 different individuals within 14 days. Communication between P00107 and P00350 spiked to 4 contacts within 3 hours on 2025-04-05.
